content: GitHub Actions now supports background steps (released 2026-06-25): 'background: true' runs a step asynchronously, 'wait'/'wait-all' block until named background steps finish, 'cancel' terminates a background step. The classic pattern is still 'cmd & echo $! > pid' plus a cleanup step guarded by 'if: always()' that kills the PID. On cancellation the runner sends SIGINT, then SIGTERM, then kills the process tree, so cleanup scripts that do not handle signals may not run.
